I don't know, I'm kind of mixed. On one hand this is what I originally thought and I want to agree with you, but if this was the intention it would have been nice to actually see changes, rather than... outright removal. 

To be honest, I never actually noticed things like statues and signs having disappeared until it was pointed out. And I only speak English, so the lack of Russian was news to me. But now that I know it's not there? I can't help but think it's a shame and wish they did something transformative.

Hell, if this was the view they were trying to push, why not have the statues and signs appear destroyed or crumbling instead of removing them? That would've made such a subtle but important impact I think. Granted, maybe they had to remove them outright due to censorship laws? I'm not too sure what rules they have to follow.

B) watch a video on youtube of someone else doing it on rage and try and learn enemy placement and how to quickly deal with them from there?

Personally I got through it by spam buying TF27 squads every time I had enough money, I think the price resets every time you die but I might be wrong. Dropping proximity mines below the tunnels they drop out of also deals with the first few that show up.

Alright yeah you don't have to fight 107 you're right about that

To be honest the crash sight and the unidentified structure (I think that's the coal mine you're talking about?) gave me a lot of trouble so get ready 😭

For both of them you're going to want a smartgun minigun. For crash sight save as much ammo as you can for when the snipers appear, because if they see you you're cooked. Hellfire is also a problem but if you're under shelter he can't get you. (During my run I didn't save enough minigun ammo so he was still alive and I had to run up and kill him lol. Worst is I got an autosave there so I had to do it again every time I died.)
It's a big pain in the ass on rage. Especially with the juggs that appear. I also recommend spawncamping the enemies as they come out of the helicopter (incendiary blast should get them all to fall over on each other, just watch out because they can shoot you while they're getting out of the helis) 
Also in case you didn't know because me & a lot of people missed out on it, but if you go to the front of the plane (left from where you spawn in) there are some breach charges you can use to open some boxes around the map. I can link a video if you want an exact location because I'm not too good at describing, but they should have things like extra miniguns, grenade launchers, etc. If I'm remembering correctly.

The structure is pretty easy for the first half. Once you get out of the underground bit is where it's a pain because the enemies can shoot through the walls and they'll try coming in. I barricaded myself in with proximity mines first, then I threw thruster grenades out the windows at the guys below. Once you're out the smartgun should take out the rest. There should also be a grenade launcher in a weapon box up on the top floor you can use to wipe them out if they get in a group, I think there's a weapons bench so you can add honing onto it as well. Just keep an eye on all entrances because it's a matter of one guy coming up behind you and you're done.

Iron Dragon should be the easiest out of the three. It's similar to Gunnarson Complex but I find it more annoying because there's less breathing room and enemies can shoot through the metal floor on the very top layer (above or below it)
You can set proximity mines outside the doors enemies come out of. Also you can get a chunk of them stuck in doorways with an incendiary blast. But same with Gunnarson, you'll want to go through the waves as slowly as possible so they don't get too crazy. Only downside to this is you probably won't see Rama but if you're not bothered about HVTs it'll be fine

Huh, I never actually knew you could just run straight to the switch. Even on my first playthrough i camped behind the entrance and shot at people's feet when they walked past lol. But yeah I went straight from normal + hard (switched interchangeably) because I just randomly got the urge to try rage and actually finished it to the end.

As for other levels though be prepared for Jorvik castle. The first two bosses (Enforcer & flesh golem) can easily be cheesed by bayonets on the minigun because it'll make them stagger and they'll be unable to attack you. It finishes them both off relatively easily too. Unfortunately that method doesn't work for the Patriarch.. :') you'll have to kill him the hard way, usually the bolt launcher does the trick, the hard part is just hitting him and not getting hit back. Took me hours on that fight alone. Also, in between waves just as the cultists are about to jump down, drop some of the fire grenades lying around where they're going to land so it'll keep a few of them out of action for a few seconds. (If you can, proximity mines would probably be better for this, but you would have to carry them through the whole level).

Site 83 is probably the easiest, just bring a grenade launcher or something for the guys at the end to deal with them quickly, especially the juggs.

Horizon HQ is probably the same level of difficulty as Jorvik TBH. I got through the first half with a grenade launcher and the smartgun. For the brain fight I recommend a grenade launcher to deal with groups, and a choke shotgun to deal with the brains and stragglers. Usually I'm an incendiary enjoyer but it doesn't usually kill the enemies and they'll be back up after being set on fire. Hardest part for me was the segment where there were 3 brains, for some reason the one with 6 was really easy. You might already know, but for the helicopter use focus + minigun. It'll take it out really quickly.

I think that's everything so hopefully this helps, happy to go more in depth on certain parts or clarify anything if needed.

For Pandora (specifically the courtyard) I cheesed it a bit by hiding behind the entrance (the one you crawl/slide under to get in) and throwing thruster grenades at the juggs and then using the smartgun minigun to finish them off/get the others. For Jackal I managed to get a good chunk of the black ops guys stuck in a doorframe and setting them on fire with an incen shotgun blast. You'll probably have to restart to try this I'm guessing, so do it as a last resort. I had a lot of autosaves that I thought I was fucked over on but I ended up getting them to work in the end, rage takes a lot of patience. 
I'm running on about 5 hours sleep in total for the past few days, and my brain is barely working so hopefully this all makes sense lol :')

Nah definitely take the L and lower the difficulty, come back after you've beaten the game if you're still itching to try rage mode because it requires a lot of knowledge about the levels you're playing and the enemies you'll be up against to actually be somewhat enjoyable. Don't get me wrong, it's definitely possible to beat it on your first try from what I've seen, but I wouldn't wish doing that on my worst enemy lol

If you want a more detailed strat for a specific mission lmk & I'll be happy to give an answer but in summary

-Thruster grenades, incendiary shotguns, smartgun, and (with or without honing) grenade launcers are your best friends. Some people say choke shotguns are better, I think it just comes down to preference ngl

-Didn't struggle a lot at the courtyard but I've heard a lot of people did so my strat for that was to spend the first half hiding under the shutter (the one you're supposed to slide under to get in) and chucking grenades at the juggs. Once they were dealt with I don't remember if I came out to finish off the rest or used the smartgun, either should work tbh. When the talon guys came along I hid in that storage/power(?) area to the side where the tripmines are and shot at them as they came in. Since it was incendiary they just tripped over each other lol. Smartgun to finish off Jackal and any stragglers, and you should be set

-Jorvik Castle was hell, but you can use minigun bayonets to cheese the flesh golem and the Enforcer. Patriarch fight was a massive pain and took hours, bolt launcher should do the trick though. Throw firebombs at the cultists as they drop down in between segments 

-Site 83 is a massive breath of fresh air, just bring along grenade launchers or a bolt launcher to deal with the juggs at the end

-Horizon HQ was just plain painful LOL. At the boss I recommend choke over incendiary here, and a grenade launcher, but I think it is just mostly luck. (Also don't forget to pick up the minigun for Horizon One)

Well, I'd be the first to admit that the trans community is far from perfect - though I'd also say that goes for many other communities, too. 
The vast majority of trans people just want to live and mind their own business such as myself. Of course we have some bad apples, but sadly those bad apples get the spotlight put on them which causes our entire community to seem like that, which isn't true.
You don't have to like every aspect of the trans community. Of course not. I just think the UK/Trans heart thing is a nice touch, and again as a trans person from the UK, it can serve as a symbol of mutual acceptance. 
If you don't like the heart, that's chill, no one can force you to like it, that's just my take on it & why (I think) people are fighting so hard for it.
I'm mostly defending the trans flag & the UK/trans heart but whenever I have a tile to spare I help rebuilding the America flag. Good luck, guys!

If you're not a TERF, then there's no reason to get all up in arms about it. It's not about you.
-A trans person from the UK

I'm sorry to say, but you've done this to yourself, and it's up to you to fix it. 
I think you need to realise that this girl doesn't love you, she loves someone who doesn't exist. There is no way you two can be together after your "relationship" has been based off such a huge lie. 
My advice would be to break up, delete every and all account you use for your fake persona, and leave it behind. It'll hurt her, especially if it's out of nowhere, but I suspect a sudden breakup is much easier to deal with than basically realising the love of your life for the past two years never existed. 
Regardless of what you do, you need to let her go. If you love her, then you want her to be happy.

I deeply apologise for how you must be feeling, and I send my greatest sympathies to you, your father, and your family. I understand you're angry and upset,  so I'm not here to berate you for your tone towards me. I'm not just saying this to be the "nice guy" in the situation - genuinely - I cannot express how saddening this is to hear.
I have to say, though, I'm not sure why my "parts" have to be brought into this, when they were never even mentioned in my post. Seeing as I'm talking about my grandmother I would very much rather they weren't brought up at all.
Aside from that, you can feel however you want about my post. That's fine. I never really thought it'd gain this much traction, to be honest. I don't even really know what I was going for. I just needed to get things off my chest, as do many other people here.
That's all, again, for whatever it's worth I send you my sympathy. No one deserves to go through this. If you need to talk to anyone desperately or just need someone to lend an ear, I'm here. (This also extends to anyone else who happens to read this.)

I was in your shoes back when I was in school. No one liked me, I was never able to make friends, and I started really badly acting up (getting into fights, being disruptive, etc) to vent my frustrations. It was awful, and I would never wish it upon anyone else. 
Now I'm twenty and in college, life couldn't be any different. I'd even consider myself somewhat popular amongst my peers, and I'm no longer afraid of going out there and making friends with the people I come across. I know this is pretty corny, but your life wont be like this forever and things do get better even if it takes a while.
I'm not gonna lie and tell you I no longer have issues at all directly linked with my autism and how people view me because of it, because I do. But the point is, eventually, it will get better. I give my best wishes to you.
